thread:
maria: heads-up — I'm tuning the prefix/kv hit-rate alerts for a customer hitting regressions this morning. Where's the canonical grafana dashboard and any eviction/trace runbook?
joel: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv-prefetch-metrics?orgId=1 :link:  panels: Prefetch hit-rate, eviction_rate, tail_latency.
anya: for traces check Jaeger -> service=kv-store, operation=evict_prefix. We added a span tag `prefix_key` last quarter.
sam: if you want a quick hit-rate query, use:
```
sum(rate(kv_prefix_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_prefix_requests_total[5m]))
```
alex: also watch the `kv.prefetch.sampled_miss_count` histogram — that caught a rollout issue last week.
sre-bot: Alert config link: https://infra.redwood.internal/alerts/kv-prefetch-hitrate. Current threshold: 0.6 over 10m for production.
maria: thanks — is the alert owner still @joel oncall? I want to lower the sensitivity for one customer without noisy pages. :thinking_face:
joel: still me. For low-noise run, set `for: 30m` and bump threshold to 0.55, but keep a separate pager if eviction_rate > 0.01/sec.
anya: if you do that, add a screener: exclude tenant_id=internal-test in the query so the synthetic load doesn't skew it.
maria: good call. I'll open a small PR to update the alert. tagging owners for review. @joel @sam :raising_hand:
sam: quick review look good — please include a note in the alert description with the grafana panel link and the Jaeger trace example.
joel: will approve once the PR includes the `for` change + exclusion and a short rollback note.
maria: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/PR/4321 — description + query snippets included.
anya: :eyes: will skim in the next hour. If you want faster, ping me in threads.
maria: pinging in case someone oncall needs to re-route pages: this reduces page churn for the customer's noisy prefix churn.
alex: FYI ops playbook for cache eviction is under docs/internal/cache-evictions.md (link in the grafana dashboard).
maria: perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
joel: thanks — post-merge I'll monitor the alert for a day and post results here.
